The '''Torve system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The system contained at least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="FBS" /> Sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Bronzium Brigade]] operated out of the Torve system.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Lant Mining Corporation]] established surface mining operations on the system's planets.<ref name="FBS" />
